item.title: Stalwart is now a drop-in replacement for Microsoft Exchange
item.description: Stalwart 1.2.0 speaks MAPI over HTTP, Exchange Web Services, ActiveSync and Autodiscover, so Outlook, Apple Mail and mobile devices connect to it as they would to an Exchange server. Also in this release: mail rules, read receipts, working hours, room and equipment booking, and the new Stalwart CLI 2.0 with an interactive console.

item.title: Gliver completes the Guix desktop -- Dustycloud Brainstorms
item.description: There's a bit of irony in the title. At the time of writing, Gliver, a Guile based window manager for Wayland in the style of StumpWM and Emacs, isn't yet in Guix. There is, however, an open PR to add Gliver to Guix. However, what that patch is really waiting on is an upcoming release of Gliver which will solve many bugs.

item.title: Toward Generalized Coding with Our First Loop Transformer
item.description: Over the past three months, we have aggressively scaled both loop depth and model size in parallel. The first surprise came from the Loop Transformer architecture itself. By executing a shared block of layers across multiple iterations, the model can reason more deeply without adding parameters, effectively matching the performance of much larger models.
